scenario: used-car dealer calling back about a test drive slot

seller.product: Used 2019 Pravah XT diesel SUV (white, first owner)
price_list: Pravah XT 2019 diesel listed at ₹7.85 lakh
Finance: minimum ₹1.5 lakh down payment, loan up to 5 years

speakers.name: Aman Chauhan
speakers.style: quick, eager, slightly over-promises, says sir every line

coaching_truths.statement: Aman claimed a full company service history before checking the file, then had to take it back; the prospect said that point matters to him.
Aman hinted at a discount ('थोड़ा बहुत हो जाएगा') as soon as the prospect pushed, before the prospect had even seen the car.
When the prospect asked for a loan, Aman gave terms but never asked his budget, monthly EMI comfort or the exchange car's condition and ownership.
Aman welcomed the wife's test drive and set a clear 20-25 minute highway drive, which suits a joint family decision.
